notes_for_editor: Very thin. The FFLA list gives only the name, county, coordinates, type (Crows Nest) and status (Gone). The Forest Lookouts page gives only the name and the Gila National Forest heading. The roadless-area page describes the mountain and trail, not the lookout. No build date, builder, staffing or fire history was found, and the story leaves those out. Type: FFLA says Crows Nest; the record says platform. Not changed, as the two are close and no source says more. The lookout's point was not checked against the mountain's location. No access level is set because the sources describe national forest land on the Continental Divide Trail, not the lookout site. Two WebSearch queries returned nothing about the lookout itself.
